A '''Duros''' was the [[mayor]] of a [[Unidentified city (Cad Bane)|city]] during the [[Republic Era]]. When [[Niro]] visited the town hall the [[Duros]] mayor advised [[Death|killing]] [[Cad Bane]] before he struck, but [[Niro]] did not believe that anyone needed to die. After Bane murdered Niro, the mayor adopted his son [[Isaac]].<ref name="One Good Deed" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the Scenes==
The Mayor was voiced by [[Gwendoline Yeo]]<ref name="One Good Deed" /> who also voiced [[Kalifa]]<ref name="Padawan Lost">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref> and [[Nala Se]]  from ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
